notes: «قال وحدثني محمد» opens a second isnad of the same saying (rule 4): its own group; its head «محمد» is a bare name and is not identified (rule 9)
«أنس» stands twice: occurrence 1 for the first isnad, occurrence 2 for the second
The first isnad carries only the short matn; the second carries the longer story of the she-camel, the same saying
